newItems.zh: 黑色星期五(感恩节后的大促销日)
newItems.noteZh: 感恩节后的那个星期五,美国很多商店一大早就开始大减价,人特别多;两个词首字母都大写。
美式 a 读 /ɑː/,和 ball 押韵;at the mall 在商场。
a long line 长队,wait in line 排队;英式英语说 queue。l 舌尖顶住上齿龈,别读成 n。
The mall was really crowded. 商场里特别挤;-ed 跟在 d 后面读 /ɪd/:“CROW-did”。
w 双唇收圆往前送,别读成 v;a 读 /ɑː/:“WAH-lit”。
ir 读 /ɝː/,舌头卷起来;shirt 一般指有领子、有扣子的衬衫,T-shirt 是 T 恤。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Hi, Lei! How was Black Friday?
lines.zh: (感恩节后的周一,没去商场的索菲亚问磊)嗨,磊!黑色星期五怎么样?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: It was really crowded! There were a lot of people at the mall.
lines.zh: 特别挤!商场里人山人海。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Yes, there was a long line at every store.
lines.zh: 排了,每家店门口都排着长队。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Yes! Shirts were fifty percent off.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I wanted a jacket, but there weren't any mediums.
lines.zh: 我想买一件外套,可是中号的都没有了。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Oh no! So what did you buy? Was it fun?
lines.zh: 哎呀!那你买了什么?好玩吗?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: A wallet for my dad. That's it!
lines.zh: 给我爸买了一个钱包。就这些!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I was so tired, but it was fun!

questions.prompt: 黑色星期五那天,商场里怎么样?
options: 特别挤,每家店都排着长队
questions.explainZh: 磊说 It was really crowded!(特别挤!)和 there was a long line at every store(每家店门口都排着长队)。
I wanted a jacket, but there weren't any mediums.(我想买外套,可是中号的都没有了。)
A wallet for my dad. That's it!(给我爸买了一个钱包,就这些!)衬衫打五折,但他没说买了。

grammar.titleZh: There was / There were:过去某处有……
grammar.bodyZh: 第 5 单元的 There is / There are 说“现在某处有……”;说过去,就把 is 换成 was,are 换成 were:There was a long line at every store.(每家店门口都排着长队。)There were a lot of people at the mall.(商场里人很多。)用 was 还是 were,看 there 后面的名词:单数、不可数用 was,复数用 were。否定:There wasn't… / There weren't any…(There weren't any mediums. 中号的都没有了)。问句把 was / were 放到 there 前面:Was there…? / Were there any good deals?,回答 Yes, there was. / No, there weren't.。中文说“商场里有很多人”,别照着语序说成 At the mall had a lot of people.。

examples.text: There was a long line at every store.
examples.zh: 每家店门口都排着长队。

examples.text: There were a lot of people at the mall.
There weren't any jackets in a medium.
Were there any good deals? — Yes, there were.

grammar.titleZh: 发音:/ɝː/;was 和 were 的强弱
grammar.bodyZh: were、first、shirt、Thursday 里的 er、ir、ur 都读 /ɝː/:舌头卷起来往后收,舌尖不碰上颚,嘴不要张大,别读成“窝”或“沃”。在句子中间,were 常弱读成 /wɚ/,was 弱读成 /wəz/;放在简短回答的句末就要读重:Yes, there were. / Yes, there was.。黑色星期五是感恩节(11 月第四个星期四)后的那个星期五,很多商店一大早就开始大减价。

examples.text: It was my first Black Friday.
examples.zh: 那是我第一次过黑色星期五。

examples.text: Were there long lines? — Yes, there were.
